Privacy Policy

Last updated: October 2026

BrewNest collects only minimum personal data to process your reservation: name, phone, date, time, guest count, and optional special requests.

What we collect

  • Name and phone number (to confirm reservation)
  • Date, time and occasion (to prepare your table)
  • Special requests — optional

How we use it

Your data is used only to confirm and fulfil your reservation. We do not sell or share it for marketing.

Your rights (India DPDP Act 2023)

You may request access, correction or deletion by emailing hello@brewnest.in. We will respond within 30 days.

Cookies

We use one essential cookie to store your consent preference. No tracking or advertising cookies are used.

Terms & Conditions

Last updated: October 2026

By making a reservation or using this website, you agree to these terms.

Reservations

  • Tables held for 15 minutes past booked time.
  • For 5+ guests, please call to confirm.
  • We reserve the right to refuse service.

Pricing

Menu prices shown are indicative and may vary at the cafe. Event prices subject to change.

Cookie Policy

Last updated: October 2026

This website uses only one cookie:

  • bn_cookie — stores your consent choice. Expires in 365 days.

No analytics, advertising, or third-party tracking cookies are used. You can delete cookies via your browser settings.

Refund Policy

Last updated: October 2026

Reservations via this website are free — no advance payment or deposit is taken online.

In-cafe issues

If you are unsatisfied with any item at the cafe, please speak with our staff immediately. We are happy to replace or refund items that do not meet our standard.
